thread:
Owen: Heads-up — Savanna Microsystems offered a 3-week dry-run on their EdgeRack appliance. They'll provide images, per-step power CSVs, and a short feedback questionnaire. NDA required (vendor-supplied). Can someone own the infra side? cc @Priya @Marta :wave:

Priya: I can pick up the harness + initial runs. Which model families are we targeting? 13B and 40B ok?

Marta: 13B for latency, 40B for sustained long-context (24k). Also want cold-start vs warmed KV cache. Metrics: p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, mem high-water, and power-mean/peak. Aim to have draft results by 2024-04-16 so partnerships can prep an embargoed summary.

Legal-Bot: Reminder: Savanna's NDA permits internal evaluation only. No external release without explicit partner sign-off. I'll post the NDA checklist to the repo and require 72h review for any external slides.

Savanna-Rep: Hi all — we'll send the appliance image, SSH accounts, and a telemetry JSON schema. Power CSVs will be timestamped in ISO8601. We can also run a paired smoke test if you want to observe.

Priya: Nice. I'll stub the repo: https://git.redwood/integration/savanna-edgerack and add a reproducible run script. Quick smoke command I plan to use:
```ssh savanna@edgerack
sudo ./bench_runner --model redwood/40b-24k --seq 24576 --warm 300 --iters 400
```

Infra-CI: Reserved three sandbox nodes for week of 2024-04-09. Image uploaded to s3://savanna-preview/edgerack-20240401.img (22.7G). Network and SSH creds stored in repo secrets.

Marta: Telemetry plan: capture KV cache hits, per-token latency spans, and ingest power CSVs. If Savanna provides an ingest endpoint we can POST JSON; otherwise we'll fetch CSVs to S3 and annotate runs.

Savanna-Rep: We'll provide an HTTPS ingest and API token, plus CSVs in case you prefer S3. Token and sample payloads coming tomorrow. Happy to do a live smoke on Wed.

Owen: Sync Wed 11:00 PT. Agenda: access creds, telemetry contract/schema, bench matrix, legal embargo flow, and the partner feedback form. Add pre-reads to the repo and mark anything embargoed. :calendar:
